# Divija MV

Backend-leaning TypeScript engineer in Bengaluru. Co-Founder and CTO at BrainReef,
founding engineer at Fuleex. Works on correctness under concurrency: append-only
billing ledgers made exactly-once by unique constraint, payment webhooks that
survive the buyer closing the tab, and multi-tenant row isolation.
